report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all checkout, order, payment and inventory spans returning 200 with ok results. Order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders (502 count 0) and payment shows no 503s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No evidence of checkout errors exists; hand off for failure telemetry.
missing_evidence: Error/failure telemetry (5xx traces or error logs) for checkout or order during the incident window
Order service logs (excluded) to confirm or refute checkout errors
Gateway logs (excluded) to confirm client-observed checkout failures
Deployment history showing a version change preceding the incident, if any
